character.originStory: Gather round, junior devs. This creature lives behind a ghost switch: one remote call and a character slips through every other player like fog. Its claws are labelled BaseballBat, GreatSword and DBShotgun, so every swing carries a file name. It arrived with no README, so it tells its tale by firelight instead. Its one habit is slipping through GameSettings.luau as if the file were fog too. Keep your coffee close, and whatever you do, don't rename its claws.
